powershell6_dependency.initial_observation: PowerShell 6.2.7 executed all 34 renderer/source contracts in the provisional 35-test snapshot, but the XML harness and its negative test aborted with No usable version of libssl was found. This was an old .NET runtime dependency failure, not a renderer exception.
powershell6_dependency.resolution: Extracted an official Debian package to a workspace-only directory and scoped LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the PS6 test process. No host package installation or generated runtime installer was added.

limitations: Tests run on Debian 13 x86_64, not original historical operating systems.
No universal OS, distribution, service manager, terminal, font, shell minor-release or future-version claim.
Exact-engine harness accepts and executes trusted input scripts; it is not a sandbox.
WMI/provider initialization and native API calls have no hard whole-render deadline; hook timeout guarantees are separate.
